scenes.text: Describe examples of God’s promises and ways believers respond to a call.
The curriculum uses stories of Abraham (Ibrahim) and Moses (Musa) when discussing God’s promises and call. Believers learn about trust, obedience, humility and service from these stories.
Responses may include prayer, helping people in need and caring for the environment. People of different faiths may explain these promises in different ways.
Retell one story of Abraham/Ibrahim or Moses/Musa respectfully using a trusted text or a teacher’s summary.
